purpose: Per-work kernel connection logging and exact lifecycle ownership, not general internet egress
build_difference: The two libvirt fixture changes were uncommitted at build time and subsequently committed unchanged as test_commit; production hook source was unchanged.
environment: Dedicated macOS 15.7.3 M4 Pro / Lima Ubuntu 24.04 ARM64 / nested KVM / libvirt 10 / nftables 1.0.9
kernel_test_boundary: Root in a fresh network namespace distinct from PID 1; real nft creation, exact snapshot, duplicate refusal, missing/recreated logger rejection and handle-scoped cleanup. Journal readiness is injected in these tests, not evidence of real guest traffic or journal availability.

lifecycle_test.name: TestDedicatedLibvirtNetworkProvisioning
lifecycle_test.cases: Normal provisioning and cancellation after activation, each followed by recovery in a separate OS process

guest_test.name: TestDedicatedLibvirtLoggedControlPackets
guest_test.tls_endpoint: Credential-free HTTPS HEAD to example.com at an explicitly supplied public IPv4; transport positive control, not a dedicated production API listener

receipt_checks: All nine records are root:root, regular single-link 0644 files. Each run retains matching network and boot identities; active and stopped handles/fingerprints match. Records are retained, not deleted.
installation_boundary: Guest-flow acceptance used an exact reversible binary swap. A subsequent separate acceptance ran the final production first-install script after preserving the existing hook/guard directories, then restored all originals; these are distinct runs.

first_install.unit_initial_and_restored_state: not-found, inactive, MainPID 0; no local unit or runtime mask
first_install.network_cases: Normal and cancel-after-activation, each with new OS-process recovery; six exact root pending/active/stopped receipts retained
first_install.regression_red: Approved-digest requirement before source fix; quiescence before its implementation; missing MainPID and three command-failure propagation cases with their specific guards removed. All guards restored before successful tests and installation.

not_verified: Lossless logging, runtime journal loss/flood detection, storage retention and partial-create recovery
General repository/model internet egress or a dedicated production API destination
Complete sealed Golden Image/Runner, GUI, preview/console or concurrent two-work acceptance
Real amd64 VM boot, total VM time budgets and automatic nonterminal recovery
